notes: SR173 Chattels & More (UAE). Access as bs173.json/cl173.json. PRIMARY CANDIDATE: 'New Collection 2026' is linked in footerLinks/headerMegaMenuFooterLinks (title='New Collection 2026', link='promotion/new-collection-2026') -> promotion id=99, slug 'new-collection-2026'. Genuine PLP: 5 department children (Living/Dining/Bedroom/Accessories/Lighting), filterable/paginated listing via the same product API used by ordinary category pages. COLLECTION-PAGE INSPECTION (per brief): fetched every returned product's own 'is_new' flag as an independent cross-check that this promotion really represents newest additions. Bedroom (15/15) and Lighting (12/12) are 100% is_new=1; Living-room (87/91) and Dining (270/272) are ~96-99% is_new=1 (small exceptions, not flagged); but Accessories is only 89/139 (64%) is_new=1 - a materially large fraction (50 of 139) of the Accessories slice are NOT flagged 'new' by the site's own product data, suggesting this promotion mixes a themed 'New Collection' merchandising concept with some non-new stock in that department. Flagged the Accessories row only, per brief instruction on ambiguous Collection pages. Fetched full per_page>=total listings for all 5 departments (last_page=1 confirmed exhaustive) and found only 1 cross-listed product (id 12850, Amy Buffet storage cabinet, in both Living and Dining) out of 529 - not deduplicated, both totals are genuinely what the site reports per department. ADDITIONAL CANDIDATES found only via direct /api/promotion/<slug> probing (matching the confirmed [locale]/promotion/[promotion] route pattern) - NEITHER appears anywhere in the homepage HTML, main nav, footer, mobile menu, or sitemap.xml (checked by string search - zero hits for both slugs): (1) promotion id=5, slug='new-arrivals', name='New Arrivals' (the brief's own primary target term) - but only 1 of the site's 5 promotion-eligible departments is configured (Bedroom only, 12 products), and its banner image file is literally named 'Back to Home - Desktop.png'/'...Mobile.png', which does not match a New-Arrivals theme at all - strong signal this is a stale/repurposed leftover page, not a currently-tended listing. (2) promotion id=36, slug='new-in', name='New In' - 4 departments configured (Living/Dining/Accessories/Lighting, no Bedroom), banner asset named 'New Arrivals LP DT.webp' (uploaded ~Jun 2025), 22 products total. Verified both are NOT subsets/aliases of New Collection 2026 or of each other: id5(bedroom) vs id99(bedroom) share 0/12 products; id36 vs id99 share 0-1 products per department (essentially disjoint). All three are therefore recorded as distinct genuine listings, but id5 and id36 carry an additional MANUAL REVIEW flag for zero on-site discoverability. Navigation discovery also covered: full headerMainMenu, footerLinks, headerMegaMenuFooterLinks, mobile menus, footer 'POPULAR' block (no other new-arrivals-shaped term), sitemap.xml grep for new-in/new-arrivals/just-in/whats-new/latest-arrivals/new-products (zero matches), and direct API probes for those same slugs plus 'latest-arrivals' (all 'Promotion not found' except new-arrivals/new-in already covered). The i18n table's 'latest_arrivals':'Latest Arrivals' string is a sort-order option inside ordinary category listings, not a dedicated page - not emitted as a row.
